_comment: The English UI strings: the reference every site/i18n/<locale>/strings.json translates. Partials use them as {{t:key}} (HTML) or {{tj:key}} (JavaScript); scripts/build_site.py uses the rest. {name} is filled in by the generator and must stay in every translation. The site.json nav is translated gettext style in each locale's "nav" object, keyed by the English text. See scripts/site_i18n.py.
